items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Scan every pushed commit for secrets**

`git diff <remote>..<local>` compares the two endpoint trees; it does not emit each commit in the pushed range (as confirmed by the inspected `git diff -h` two-commit form). If a branch introduces a token in one commit and removes it in a later commit before pushing both, this diff is clean and the hook allows the secret-bearing commit into the remote history. Scan the patches for every newly reachable commit rather than only the net tree difference.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/1763da66ae0d86ad2e7d481072cba27be41dfc71/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Run staged checks against index contents**

These commands receive names selected from the index but read each file from the working tree. With a partially staged file, a developer can stage malformed content and then fix only the unstaged working-tree copy; shfmt, ruff, prettier, and the shellcheck path below inspect the fixed copy and allow the malformed staged blob to be committed. The closed hook test never creates an index/worktree divergence, so it does not close this promised staged-content control.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/1763da66ae0d86ad2e7d481072cba27be41dfc71/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)

items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject failed precheck records at acceptance**

When `PRECHECK_REQUIRED=1`, a generated record containing `checks[].ok: false` or a failed selector still passes this gate as long as its hash and `head` match, because only the `head` field is read; the newest RESULT's `status=blocked` is also ignored. Thus an `accepted` ACCEPTANCE can be dispatched against the exact failed precheck that this control is intended to enforce. Require the RESULT to be ready for review and validate that every non-deferred check and selector succeeded.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L78-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/1763da66ae0d86ad2e7d481072cba27be41dfc71/AGENTS.md#L78-L78)
